subject: Pilot acceptance and kickoff playback - Velotek discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@velotek.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: discovery + pilot ask

Thanks again for the call earlier — good convo. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can land a pilot scope.

Pain points we stated on the call:
- Production latency spikes during peak queries (esp. longer documents) causing customer drop-off.
- High and unpredictable per-request costs across current open-source hosts; need unit-cost predictability.
- Data residency / compliance constraints for a subset of EU customers (need on-prem or VPC option).

What we'd like from a 6-week pilot:
- Confirmed throughput target (sustained 50 req/s) and 95th percentile latency < 150ms for 1k-token requests.
- End-to-end cost estimate at our observed volume; a per-1k-token cost target to evaluate ROI.
- Validation that Redwood Private can meet our VPC + KMS requirements for PII processing.

Attached: our SOC 2 questions doc and a short dataset sample (redacted).

Next steps we propose: send a compact scope + owners, agree on a kickoff date (week of 7/20), and provide an initial list of accounts/roles for AWS/VPC access.

-Marta
Head of Product, Velotek

Attachments: velotek-soc2-questions.pdf (pdf), sample-data-redacted.csv (csv)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@velotek.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 18:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery + pilot ask

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear recap and for the SOC2 packet. I pulled together an initial pilot playback below so we have the same expectations before kickoff. Please review and flag any missing items.

Scope (6 weeks):
- Inference target: 50 req/s sustained; 95th percentile latency target <= 150ms for requests up to ~1k tokens.
- Cost baseline: Redwood will run a cost sim using your sample workload; we'll provide a per-1k-token estimate and an expected monthly cost band.
- Privacy/hosting: Run in a VPC-backed Private deployment in us-west-2; KMS integration for key management + audit logs.
- Evaluation: a prompt set (x100 prompts) and an acceptance eval (precision on intent extraction + hallucination rate threshold <= 3%).

Owners / Contacts:
- Velotek: Marta Lopez (Product), Sal Khan (Infra/security) — will provide AWS role & data access.
- Redwood: Kimberly Park (Engg lead / primary contact), Vivek Kulkarni (AE), Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer — infra & deployment).

Access needed from Velotek before kickoff:
1) IAM role ARN or cross-account role for RW deployment (instructions below).
2) Sample dataset for prompt/eval (already received — thanks).
3) IP ranges for VPC peering / firewall (or a temporary VPN).

Deliverables by end of pilot:
- Mutual Action Plan doc with milestones and owners (I'll share a live link).
- Performance & cost report with token-level breakdown and optimization recommendations.
- A short runbook for production rollout steps.

Proposed timeline:
- Confirm scope & access by 7/16.
- Kickoff & environment provisioning week of 7/20.
- Pilot execution: 6 weeks starting 7/21.
- Final demo & acceptance: week of 9/1.

I'll attach a first-pass pilot plan (word) and a runbook stub. Ben — looping you for the VPC details.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot-plan-velotek-v1.docx, runbook-vpc-setup.md
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@velotek.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery + pilot ask — technical prep

Hi Marta / Kim — quick technical notes to speed provisioning.

What we need from Velotek for VPC-backed pilot:
- One cross-account IAM role with STS AssumeRole allowing Redwood deployment account to create ENIs and manage EC2/EFS (we'll send a minimal policy).
- VPC peering: target CIDR ranges and whether you're comfortable with route-table updates; otherwise we can do a NAT-based connectivity option.
- KMS: key ARN and a list of principals that should be able to decrypt logs (for audit).

Minimum test configuration we'll deploy for the pilot (can be adjusted):
- 2 x p4d-like nodes (for baseline perf), autoscaler policy for bursts to 4 nodes.
- KV cache TTL defaults: 30m; we'll tune after initial runs.
- Observability: token-level latency traces (sampled at 10%), per-route cost telemetry.

Ben will share a small Terraform snippet and the role policy this afternoon.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sal Khan <sal.khan@velotek.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery + pilot ask — technical prep

Thanks — aligns with our expectations. A few clarifications from infra/security: 

- Start date: target provisioning week of 7/20 (we can make 7/21 the formal kickoff).
- Success thresholds: agreed 95th <= 150ms for 1k-token canonical prompt set; throughput target 50 req/s sustained with 10% burst headroom.
- Cost target: will consider any per-1k-token number you model; our internal target is <= $0.45 / 1k tokens for inference-only costs.
- Compliance: Velotek will need SOC 2 evidence and a short data-flow diagram from Redwood.

We uploaded procurement paperwork to DocuSign (link below) and attached the network CIDRs for peering. We'll provide a cross-account role by Friday EOD.

Link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/VEL-Procurement-12345
Attachments: velotek-network-cidrs.csv

-Sal
VP Infrastructure, Velotek

Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery + pilot ask — mutual action plan + kickoff

Great — thanks for the confirmation and for starting the DocuSign flow. Next steps from Redwood:

1) I'll share a live Mutual Action Plan doc (link below) with the milestone table and owners. Please add Sal's expected role ARN once available.
2) Ben will post the minimal IAM policy + Terraform snippet to the shared Drive by EOD.
3) Vivek and I will schedule a 45-minute kickoff on 7/21 (provisioning window 7/21–7/23).
4) Redwood will produce an initial performance & cost projection within 72 hours of environment availability.

Mutual Action Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c4d-velotek-mutual-action-plan
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/VEL-Procurement-12345

If that all looks good I’ll lock the kickoff for 7/21 at 09:00 PT — please confirm availability.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to working together.

Best,
